subject: Post-call recap: TCO snapshot, batching & cache levers (Acquaint Financial)
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acquaintfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap: TCO snapshot, batching & cache levers (Acquaint Financial)

Hi Sarah — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps.

Key pain points you shared:
- High per-transaction latency and apparent token spike on peak hours (loan decisioning flow).
- Predictability concerns: finance needs a bounded monthly spend number for Q4.
- Ops overhead: current infra requires manual scaling and frequent retries.

Goals you described:
- Proof a 3-month pilot (read-only inference) to validate latency and unit cost before expanding to write-paths.
- Achieve ~40–60% per-token cost reduction on typical peak distribution within pilot via batching + KV caching.
- Lock a commitment path if pilot meets < $0.002/token effective (post-levers) and 99th percentile latency < 450ms.

Prelim economic snapshot (attached: redwood_econ_snapshot_acquaint_v1.pdf):
- Baseline: estimated 1.6M tokens/day (current peak model mix) => projected $46k/mo at current settings.
- Pilot (scope below): test with 100–300k tokens/day on historical replay => estimated $9k–$18k/mo.
- Levers and expected uplift: batching (20–35% savings on peak throughput), prefix/KV caching (15–30% savings depending on hit-rate), model selection/quantization (additional 10–20%). Combined near-term target = 40–60% reduction in unit cost on pilot workload.

Recommended pilot scope and timeline:
1) Pilot scope: read-only decisioning calls (no PII routed to Redwood), 8–12 endpoint traffic samples, 4-week replay + 4-week live validation.
2) Success criteria: <= $0.002/token effective AND 99th pct latency < 450ms on live validation.
3) Ops: Redwood provides a pilot SOW and an initial config with autoscaling, default batching settings, and an instrumentation dashboard.
4) Commitment path: if success -> 6–12 month reserved commit (Dedicated or committed credits) with ramp discounts and an SLA.

Immediate next steps (today -> Friday):
- I’ll send the pilot SOW draft and the econ snapshot (attached).
- Can you confirm the internal finance reviewer and whether you have a hard Q4 budget cap? (You mentioned a mid-five-figure runway.)
- If helpful, I can prepare 3 commit options (conservative / balanced / aggressive) showing pricing, expected unit economics, and runway.

Attachments: redwood_econ_snapshot_acquaint_v1.pdf, pilot_sow_draft_acquaint.docx

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the SOW and a 3-option commit slate by EOD Thursday.

Best,
Jonas
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
jonas@redwood.ai

——

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acquaintfin.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: TCO snapshot, batching & cache levers (Acquaint Financial)

Jonas — thanks, this is super helpful and matches what we took away. A couple clarifying items from our side: 

1) Budget: we have roughly $120k in total cloud/third-party budget for Q4 for experimentation. For a pilot we can allocate up to $30k over 2 months if we see strong results, but finance will require a clear ROI statement before approving any reserve commit.

2) Data / Compliance: decisioning flow includes hashed user ids and some derived attributes; we need to confirm that this qualifies as non-PII for your pilot ingestion. Also can you provide (or point us to) your SOC 2 and data retention docs?

3) Numbers: the $0.002/token threshold sounds reasonable if that’s net after the batching/cache/quantization recommendations. Can you note the assumptions behind the 1.6M tokens/day baseline (which models, prompt sizes)?

4) Timeline: we are in a freeze window mid-August for product releases — earliest active pilot start for our infra team would be first week of September.

Would be great to see the 3-option commit slate you mentioned (one-pager). Also loop in our finance reviewer when you have it.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Platform Engineering | Acquaint Financial
sarah@acquaintfin.com

——

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: TCO snapshot, batching & cache levers (Acquaint Financial)

Looping in internal sales approach notes — quick points: 
- Sarah’s budget note is explicit: $30k pilot top-line, finance wants ROI trail for any reserve commit. We should structure the 3 options as: (A) Pilot-only (no commitment), (B) Pilot -> 6mo conservative commit (discounted), (C) Pilot -> 12mo aggressive commit (deeper discount + priority capacity).
- Include a clear line-item showing expected net token price after levers at 10/25/40% batching+cache assumptions so finance can see sensitivity.
- Ben, please sanity-check the 1.6M baseline assumptions and share a 1‑pager on model mix + avg tokens per call (we’ll include in the econ PDF).

I’ll draft the 3-option commit slate and an ROI one-pager; Jonas, if you can add the latency SLO and instrumentation bullets that would make the finance review quicker.

Marissa
VP, Growth | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai

——

From: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah@acquaintfin.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 24 Jul 2025 09:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap: TCO snapshot, batching & cache levers (Acquaint Financial)

Thanks Sarah — appreciate the clarity. Quick responses and proposed next logistics: 

- Baseline assumptions: 1.6M tokens/day assumes 3 models in your mix (short prompt decision model ~40 tokens avg, mid-length enrichment ~180 tokens, longer explainability traces ~600 tokens) weighted by current traffic (60% / 30% / 10%). Ben will send the model-mix note by EOD.
- Compliance docs: linking the SOC 2 & retention summary here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AqAcqPilotDocs (we'll also attach a redacted retention table in the SOW).
- Pilot start: we’ll target a Sep 1 start in the SOW with a 4w replay + 4w live window to match your freeze and product calendar.
- Deliverables by our team (timeline for your review):
   * EOD Thu: 3-option commit slate (one-pager) + ROI sensitivity table (Jonas/Marissa).
   * Fri: Pilot SOW draft (Jonas) + econ PDF updated with model-mix numbers (Ben).
   * After your internal finance review: 30-min follow-up with finance + infra (we can do week of Aug 4 or Aug 11).

If that all works, I’ll send the 3-option PDF now and the SOW shortly.

Best,
Jonas
